statement: Under the charged-bipartition and (e,s)-core definitions fixed in problem.md, for every integer n >= 0 one has [q^n] c_{6,(0,1)}(q) > 0. More precisely, c_{6,(0,1)}(q) = (q^2;q^2)_infinity^3 (q^6;q^6)_infinity^2 (q^12;q^12)_infinity^2 / (q;q)_infinity^2 = psi(q)^2 c_3(q^2) psi(q^6). No assertion is made that the (0,3) branch is proved; the original conjunction remains unresolved.
contribution: This proves one of the two e=6 charged-bipartition positivity branches that Gerber--Norton list as conjectural. The proof identifies the abacus series with six A5 lattice-coset theta series, certifies the eta-product identity using a common multiplier and an exact Sturm bound, and derives all-degree positivity from an explicit square-size 3-core family and Legendre's three-square theorem. Priority beyond the bounded literature comparison is not asserted.
